what_happened: On a multi-lane highway the policy slowed from 7.9 to 4.4 m/s and drifted left across the lane line, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. Its front hit vehicle 41, which was passing in the adjacent left lane.

On a multi-lane highway the command was RIGHT, but the ego's path veered left over the lane line, about 1.6 m from the recorded human path. Its front hit the rear of actor 41, a white pickup moving up alongside in the left lane.

On a straight multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle close by, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (20 to 8 m/s) and drifted left across the lane line. Its front hit the rear-right corner of actor 1, which was passing in the left lane. A following vehicle then struck the ego's rear because of the sudden slowdown.

On a multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle within about 50 m, the policy braked hard for no clear reason (20 → 9 m/s) and its planned path bent left toward the next lane. Actor 1 was driving in that lane and pulled alongside, then slightly ahead, as the ego slowed. The ego's front-left corner then hit actor 1's rear-right while the ego was drifting left. That happened even though the command had changed to RIGHT. The hard braking probably also led to the separate rear contact.

On an open highway with no lead vehicle, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (20.3 to 8.8 m/s) and drifted left toward the adjacent lane, while the recorded path went straight and then bore right. Because the ego slowed, actor 1 in the left lane, which had been beside it, pulled ahead, and the ego's front-left corner hit its rear-right. The later rear-end contact was most likely caused by the ego's sudden braking.

On an open highway with no vehicle ahead, the ego braked hard (20.3 to 8.5 m/s) while its planned path drifted left toward the next lane, where actor 1 was driving alongside. It steered left into actor 1 and hit it with its front, then fell behind the human recording by about 12 m and was rear-ended afterward.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego slowed down and drifted left out of its lane, against a RIGHT route command and away from its planned path. Its front hit actor 41, a white SUV moving in the lane to its left alongside and slightly ahead of it (about 1.7 m off the recorded path).

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command (RIGHT in the last frame), the policy planned a drift to the left (orange path) and the ego slowed while yawing left into the neighboring lane. Its front corner hit actor 41, which was driving alongside in that lane. The lead truck was never close (gap 17–35 m), so this was not a lead-vehicle collision.

After handoff the ego braked hard (11 to about 3.5 m/s) behind lead actor 1, then began angling right toward the next lane on a RIGHT command. While it was slow, about 1.3 m left of the recorded path and turning, its left side came into lateral contact with actor 33, which was coming up alongside on the left.

On the freeway the ego braked hard behind lead car 1, dropping from 11 to about 3.5 m/s even after the lead pulled away, while sitting about 1.4 m left of the logged path near the left lane line. Actor 33, a replayed car coming up fast in the left lane, then side-swiped the ego's left rear quarter. The ego's slow speed and leftward offset put it where the log had no car, but 33 did the driving into it.

With a clear road ahead, the ego braked from 11 to about 3 m/s, then drifted left across the lane line, against a RIGHT route command. It cut into the left lane and side-swiped actor 23, which was coming up at normal speed in that lane.

After handoff the ego closed on lead vehicle 1 too fast (about 6 m gap at 11 m/s) and braked hard to about 3.5 m/s. It then angled left across the lane line toward the adjacent lane, even though the route command was RIGHT. Actor 33, a replayed car coming up from behind on the left at normal speed, side-swiped the ego, so the failure is a lateral contact plus a later rear contact.

After slowing behind actor 12 in dense highway traffic, the ego moved left into the next lane, against a RIGHT command and away from the recorded path, which went right. Its side hit actor 56, which was coming up in that left lane, at about 4 m/s; the collision registered as lateral.
